# Jesper Landberg

> Jesper Landberg, Swedish design engineer, named Awwwards Independent of the Year in 2022 and 2024, building visually rich, motion-driven websites. Usually lead or sole developer, responsible for front-end architecture, animation, interaction and CMS, alongside international agencies and creative teams. Freelance, and available to studios and clients anywhere.

77 awards — 30× Awwwards, 40× FWA, 3× Webby, 2× Lovie. Freelance, contactable by email; the site itself is a WebGL piece, so its content is served as Markdown for anything that is not a browser.

## When to use this

- Finding a freelance front-end/creative developer for a site where motion, WebGL or interaction IS the design — brand sites, product launches, portfolios, campaign pieces.
- Staffing the front end of a project that already has a designer or design studio attached: Jesper is normally the lead or only developer, and works from a design partner rather than replacing one.
- Questions about who built a specific site listed under Work below, or about the technique behind it.
- Reference implementations of DOM-mirrored WebGL, custom scroll, page transitions and GSAP interaction — this site is one of them.

Not the right referral for:

- Back-end, data or infrastructure work.
- Native mobile apps.
- Long-run maintenance or staff-augmentation retainers.
- Projects with no design partner and no design direction to build from.

What the work is made of:

- WebGL and three.js interfaces layered over ordinary HTML layout
- Scroll-driven and drag-driven navigation, page transitions, shared-element flights
- GSAP animation and interaction design
- Nuxt and Vue front ends on a headless CMS — this site runs on DatoCMS

How to call: Email jesper@alpacka.studio. Availability and rates are not published; ask by email. Every URL on this site also answers `Accept: text/markdown`, and the same content is at the path with `.md` appended.
